Here’s the complete 12-week plan summary starting 2026-06-01, integrating strength, intensified Phase 2 cardio, symptom-aware cooling, nutrition for perimenopause and bone health, and safe testing. It’s organized by phases, with weekly structure, key prescriptions, and key modifications.

Global framework
- Weekly split: 4 lifting days + 1–2 cardio sessions (2–3 if tolerated) + 1 mobility/recovery day + 1 full rest day.
- Default week layout
  - Day 1: Lower A (squat emphasis)
  - Day 2: Upper A (bench emphasis) + optional 10–15 min Zone 2 cool-down
  - Day 3: Conditioning (primary cardio session) + mobility
  - Day 4: Lower B (hinge emphasis)
  - Day 5: Upper B (overhead/back) + optional 10–15 min Zone 2 cool-down
  - Day 6: Mobility/recovery + secondary cardio (Zone 2) or place after Day 5 lift
  - Day 7: Rest
- Cooling protocol every session: Pre-cool 10–15 min in 18–20°C room, fan-on; 500 ml cold electrolyte (6–8% carb, 300–500 mg sodium). Cold sips every 10–15 min; hand/forearm cooling 1–2 min between heavy sets; cool shower after.
- Restrictions honored: No sauna; no fasted HIIT; avoid hot environments; structure cardio/lifts in a cool indoor space.

Nutrition summary (daily targets)
- Protein 1.7–2.2 g/kg/day (30–40 g at breakfast and pre-sleep)
- Carbs 3–5 g/kg on training days; 2.5–4 g/kg on rest; 30–60 g pre-lift; 20–40 g during sessions >60 min
- Fat 0.8–1.0 g/kg; fiber 25–35 g/day
- Hydration 30–40 ml/kg/day + 500–1000 ml around training; sodium 2–3 g/day baseline (+300–500 mg in training drink)
- Bone health: Calcium 1200 mg/day (diet first), Vitamin D per labs (commonly 1000–2000 IU), K2 90–180 mcg/day if appropriate, Magnesium glycinate 300–400 mg at night, Omega-3 1–2 g EPA/DHA
- Supplements (if cleared): Creatine 3–5 g/day; collagen/gelatin 10–15 g + vitamin C 30–60 min pre tendon-heavy days

Cardio summary (heat-safe, intensified Phase 2)
- Modalities: Bike erg/rower/elliptical/incline walk, indoors with fan.
- Zones: Zone 2 RPE 5–6 (60–70% HRmax); Quality intervals RPE 7–8 (peaks 85–90% HRmax) with long recoveries.
- Placement: Quality on Day 3; Zone 2 on Day 6 or short add-ons post-Upper days.
- Autoregulation: If hot flashes or poor sleep, swap quality for 20–25 min Zone 2; reduce volume 30–50% if room >25°C.

Phase 1 (Weeks 1–4): Strength foundation + tissue capacity, low heat
- Goals: Groove technique, build tendon capacity, maintain strength with low reps/cluster options; establish aerobic base.
- Lifting theme: Main lifts 2–3 reps (75–85%), RPE 7–8; accessories RPE 7; clusters to keep set duration short.
- Cardio
  - Week 1: Zone 2 22–25 min (Day 3) + 20–22 min (Day 6)
  - Week 2–3: Zone 2 25–30 min + 22–25 min; optional light intervals 6 x 45 s @ RPE 6.5 / 90 s easy or 8–10 x 30 s @ RPE 6.5 / 90 s easy (bike), only if cool and symptom-free
  - Week 4 deload: Zone 2 18–22 min twice; no intervals
- Week-by-week lifting highlights
  - Week 1: Back squat 5 x 3 @ 75–80%; Bench 5 x 3 @ 77–82%; Deadlift 4 x 3 @ 78–83%; OHP 4 x 4 @ RPE 7–8; unilateral and back/core accessories
  - Week 2: Squat/bench/deadlift 5–6 x 2 @ 80–85%; accessories 3–4 x 5–10; pull-ups/rows 3–4 x 6–8
  - Week 3: Maintain intensity, add 1–2 cluster 1-1-1 sets on main lifts; accessories moderate
  - Week 4 deload: Reduce volume 20–30%, intensity ~70–78%, RPE 6–7

Phase 2 (Weeks 5–8): Strength-power + hypertrophy; higher-intensity cardio
- Goals: Add power primers; increase main-lift intensity with doubles/singles; hypertrophy for back/glutes/shoulders; push cardio intensity safely.
- Lifting theme: Top singles at ~85% (RPE 7–8-) on some days, then 2–3s or 1–2s back-off; accessories 6–10 reps.
- Power primers each lift day: 3–5 sets of 2–3 reps (box jump, KB swing, med-ball throws), RPE 6–7.
- Cardio (intensified)
  - Week 5 Session A (Day 3): 5 x 3 min @ RPE 7.5–8 / 2 min easy (bike), ~35 min total; Session B (Day 6): Zone 2 25–30 min
  - Week 6 Session A: 3 x 4 min @ RPE 7.5–8 / 3 min, then 6 min cruise @ upper Zone 3 (RPE 7–7.5); Session B: Zone 2 26–30 min
  - Week 7 Session A: 4 x 6 min over/unders (2 min hard RPE 7.5–8, 2 min under RPE 6–6.5, 2 min hard) with 3 min easy between; Session B: Zone 2 25–28 min
  - Week 8 deload: 3 x 3 min @ RPE 7 / 2 min easy; plus Zone 2 20–25 min
- Week-by-week lifting highlights
  - Week 5: Squat 5 x 2 @ 82–87%; Bench top single ~85% then 3 x 3 @ 80%; Deadlift 5 x 2 @ 82–87%; OHP 5 x 2 @ 80–85%; accessories 3–4 x 6–10
  - Week 6: Small load bump; Deadlift/OHP 6 x 1–2 @ 85–90% RPE 7–8; Bench top single ~87% then 4 x 2 @ 82–85%
  - Week 7: Hypertrophy tilt with short clusters: Squat 4 x 4 @ 75–78% (option 2-2 clusters); Deadlift 4 x 3 @ 78–82%; Bench 4 x 4 @ 75–80%; rows/pulls 4 x 8–12
  - Week 8 deload: Main lifts 3 x 2–3 @ 75–80% RPE 6–7; accessories 1–2 easy sets

Phase 3 (Weeks 9–12): Peak/consolidate; indicator singles; maintain cardio
- Goals: Solidify strength, keep heat low with low-rep work, deload in Week 10, then indicator singles (RPE 8) in Week 12.
- Lifting theme: Top singles @ 87–90% (RPE 8-) Weeks 9 and 11; low total volume; Week 10 deload; Week 12 indicator singles at RPE 8 with light back-offs.

  - Week 11: Squat 4 x 2 @ 85–88%; Bench 4 x 2 @ 85–88%; Deadlift 5 x 1–2 @ 87–90%; OHP 4 x 2 @ 85–88%
  - Week 12 (indicator week): Singles at RPE 8 on squat/bench/deadlift/OHP (~88–92% on good day), then 2 x 2 back-offs @ ~80–82%; minimal accessories

Mobility and flexibility (cool environment; no hot yoga)
- Two 30–40 min cool mobility/yoga sessions weekly (Day 6 + one upper-day evening), focusing on hips, thoracic spine, shoulders, ankles; integrate breath work. Use fan and cold fluids. Replace any thought of hot yoga due to heat intolerance and restrictions.

Peri-session fueling and symptom management
- Pre-lift/cardio (60–90 min prior): 30–60 g carbs + 25–35 g protein; limit caffeine to 1–2 mg/kg if well tolerated and early in day.
- During long/harder sessions: 20–40 g carbs + 300–500 mg sodium via cold drink.
- Post: 30–40 g protein + 1–1.2 g/kg carbs over 3–6 h; add salty foods if sweating.
- If hot flash during training: Pause, hand/forearm cooling 1–2 min, sip cold electrolyte, reduce next set’s reps or load slightly; extend rest.

Autoregulation rules
- If sleep <6 h or symptom flare: Cap main lift at RPE 7; cut accessory volume 20–30%; convert intervals to Zone 2 20–25 min.
- Cycle onset/heavier bleed: Swap heavy hinge day for front-squat dominant and machine hamstring work; avoid heavy Valsalva singles.
- Ambient temp >25°C: Shorten sets via clusters; extend rest; switch cardio to Zone 2 only; add 300–500 mg sodium (if BP allows).

  - Week 11: Squat 4 x 2 @ 85–88%; Bench 4 x 2 @ 85–88%; Deadlift 5 x 1–2 @ 87–90%; OHP 4 x 2 @ 85–88%
  - Week 12 (indicator week): Singles at RPE 8 on squat/bench/deadlift/OHP (~88–92% on good day), then 2 x 2 back-offs @ ~80–82%; minimal accessories

Mobility and flexibility (cool environment; no hot yoga)
- Two 30–40 min cool mobility/yoga sessions weekly (Day 6 + one upper-day evening), focusing on hips, thoracic spine, shoulders, ankles; integrate breath work. Use fan and cold fluids. Replace any thought of hot yoga due to heat intolerance and restrictions.

Peri-session fueling and symptom management
- Pre-lift/cardio (60–90 min prior): 30–60 g carbs + 25–35 g protein; limit caffeine to 1–2 mg/kg if well tolerated and early in day.
- During long/harder sessions: 20–40 g carbs + 300–500 mg sodium via cold drink.
- Post: 30–40 g protein + 1–1.2 g/kg carbs over 3–6 h; add salty foods if sweating.
- If hot flash during training: Pause, hand/forearm cooling 1–2 min, sip cold electrolyte, reduce next set’s reps or load slightly; extend rest.

Autoregulation rules
- If sleep <6 h or symptom flare: Cap main lift at RPE 7; cut accessory volume 20–30%; convert intervals to Zone 2 20–25 min.
- Cycle onset/heavier bleed: Swap heavy hinge day for front-squat dominant and machine hamstring work; avoid heavy Valsalva singles.
- Ambient temp >25°C: Shorten sets via clusters; extend rest; switch cardio to Zone 2 only; add 300–500 mg sodium (if BP allows).

Testing guidance end of block
- Preferred: Week 12 indicator singles at RPE 8 with estimated 1RMs from load/RPE or velocity.
- If true 1RM is desired: Run a separate, tightly controlled test week post-block (cool room 18–20°C, strong fan, pre-cooling, not fasted, strict cut criteria for symptoms). Test lifts on separate days or AM/PM split.

Outcomes to track weekly
- RPEs and bar speeds, hot-flash frequency/intensity, room temperature, hydration, sleep duration/quality, body weight/waist, and cardio HR recovery. Use the log to tune loads, cardio volume, and cooling for the next block.

This summary keeps the plan advanced-lifter appropriate, symptom- and heat-aware, and progressive across strength, aerobic fitness, and bone-supportive nutrition—while honoring all restrictions.
